Method of Attack: Encrypts victim files after disabling Windows services related to backup, database, security software, and other applications
Terminates processes related to security software, backup applications, and database servers
Deletes Shadow Volume Copies to prevent file recovery
Steals data before encrypting the network
Demands ransom payment in bitcoin for decryptor

Ransom note contains email address and Tor payment site
Tor payment site URL pattern: ax3spapdymip4jpy.onion
